# Slopboy repository-wide guidance

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for current architecture/workflow, [ROADMAP.md](../ROADMAP.md) for active milestones and [docs/product/long-term-vision.md](../docs/product/long-term-vision.md) for long-range decisions. Do not implement deferred Epics in an unrelated task.

Agent-native product: approved version-pinned KAPLAY/Phaser game templates; server-authenticated private drafts, shared secure manual/MCP upload; immutable game UUIDs and revisions; offline guest saves. Fantasy device restrictions are resolution/indexed color/aspect plus actual controls only. Avoid insecure untrusted execution and false preview/backend claims.
